programs.source:
Modifiers =: ;:'AUTO COR'
ModifierWords =: 'automated';'corrected'
Descriptors =: ;:'MI BC PR DR BL SH TS FZ'
DescriptorWords =: 'shallow';'patches';'partial';'low drifting';'blowing';'showers';'thunderstorm';'freezing'
Phenomena =: ;:'DZ RA SN SG IC PL GR GS UP BR FG FU VA DU SA HZ PY PO SQ FC SS DS'
PhenomenonWords =: 'drizzle';'rain';'snow';'snow grains';'ice crystals';'ice pellets';'hail';'small hail';'unknown precipitation';'mist';'fog';'smoke';'volcanic ash';'dust';'sand';'haze';'spray';'dust whirls';'squalls';'funnel cloud';'sandstorm';'duststorm'
Precipitation =: 9{.Phenomena
Amounts =: ;:'FEW SCT BKN OVC'
AmountWords =: ;:'few scattered broken overcast'
Clear =: ;:'SKC CLR NSC'
ClearWords =: 'sky clear';'clear below 12000 ft';'no significant cloud'
CloudTypes =: ;:'CB TCU'
CloudTypeWords =: 'cumulonimbus';'towering cumulus'
section =: 3 : '(<''''),(<NONE),(<NONE),(<NONE),(<0$a:),(<NONE),(<NONE),(<NONE),(<NONE),<0'
state =: 3 : '1 3 5 6{y'
calm =: 3 : '(-.0{::y)*.(0=1{::y)*.0=2{::y'
directed =: 3 : '(-.0{::y)*.-.calm y'
strength =: 3 : 'if. _1=3{::y do. 2{::y else. 3{::y end.'
parse_fraction =: 3 : 0
    p =. '/' split y
    if. 2~:#p do. NONE return. end.
    if. (-.1 1 width 0{::p)+.-.1 2 width 1{::p do. NONE return. end.
    num&>p
)
parse_wind =: 3 : 0
    t =. y
    if. 'KT'-:_2{.t do. unit =. 'KT'
    t =. _2}.t
    elseif. 'MPS'-:_3{.t do. unit =. 'MPS'
    t =. _3}.t
    else. NONE return. end.
    d =. 3{.t
    if. (-.d-:'VRB')*.-.3 3 width d do. NONE return. end.
    p =. 'G' split 3}.t
    if. (#p)>2 do. NONE return. end.
    if. -.*./(2 3)&width&>p do. NONE return. end.
    speed =. num 0{::p
    gust =. NONE
    if. 2=#p do. gust =. num 1{::p end.
    variable =. d-:'VRB'
    direction =. 0
    if. -.variable do. direction =. num d end.
    (<variable),(<direction),(<speed),(<gust),<unit
)
parse_visibility =: 3 : 0
    t =. y
    if. t-:'CAVOK' do. 'CAVOK';'P';10000;0;0;0;0 return. end.
    if. 4 4 width t do.
        if. t-:'9999' do. 'METERS';'P';10000;0;0;0;0
        else. (<'METERS'),(<''),(<num t),(<0),(<0),(<0),<0 end. return.
    end.
    if. -.'SM'-:_2{.t do. NONE return. end.
    t =. _2}.t
    p =. ' ' split t
    whole =. numerator =. denominator =. joined =. 0
    qual =. ''
    if. 2=#p do.
        if. -.1 1 width 0{::p do. NONE return. end.
        f =. parse_fraction 1{::p
        if. isnone f do. NONE return. end.
        whole =. num 0{::p
        'numerator denominator' =. f
        joined =. 1
    elseif. 1=#p do.
        if. ({.t)e.'MP' do. qual =. 1{.t
        t =. }.t end.
        if. 1 2 width t do. whole =. num t
        else.
            f =. parse_fraction t
            if. isnone f do. NONE return. end.
            'numerator denominator' =. f
        end.
    else. NONE return. end.
    (<'MILES'),(<qual),(<0),(<whole),(<numerator),(<denominator),<joined
)
parse_reading =: 3 : 0
    t =. y
    q =. ''
    if. ({.t)e.'MP' do. q =. 1{.t
    t =. }.t end.
    if. -.4 4 width t do. NONE return. end.
    (<q),<num t
)
parse_rvr =: 3 : 0
    if. 'R'~:{.y do. NONE return. end.
    p =. '/' split }.y
    if. 2~:#p do. NONE return. end.
    runway =. 0{::p
    t =. 1{::p
    if. (-.2 2 width 2{.runway)+.-.(<2}.runway)e.'';'L';'C';'R' do. NONE return. end.
    trend =. ''
    if. ({:t)e.'UDN' do. trend =. _1{.t
    t =. }:t end.
    feet =. 'FT'-:_2{.t
    if. feet do. t =. _2}.t end.
    p =. 'V' split t
    if. (#p)>2 do. NONE return. end.
    readings =. parse_reading&.>p
    if. +./isnone&>readings do. NONE return. end.
    (<runway),(<readings),(<feet),<trend
)
parse_weather =: 3 : 0
    if. y-:'NSW' do. (<''),(<0$a:),<'NSW' return. end.
    t =. y
    intensity =. ''
    if. ({.t)e.'-+' do. intensity =. 1{.t
    t =. }.t
    elseif. 'VC'-:2{.t do. intensity =. 'VC'
    t =. 2}.t end.
    if. (0=#t)+.2|#t do. NONE return. end.
    codes =. 0$a:
    while. #t do. codes =. codes,<2{.t
    t =. 2}.t end.
    if. -.*./codes e.Descriptors,Phenomena do. NONE return. end.
    (<intensity),(<codes),<y
)
parse_cloud =: 3 : 0
    if. (<y)e.Clear do. (<y),(<NONE),(<'') ,<y return. end.
    if. ('VV'-:2{.y)*.3 3 width 2}.y do. (<'VV'),(<100*num 2}.y),(<'') ,<y return. end.
    a =. 3{.y
    h =. 3{.3}.y
    c =. 6}.y
    if. ((<a)e.Amounts)*.(3 3 width h)*.(<c)e.(<''),CloudTypes do.
        (<a),(<100*num h),(<c),<y
    else. NONE end.
)
celsius =: 3 : 0
    t =. y
    sign =. 1
    if. 'M'={.t do. sign =. _1
    t =. }.t end.
    if. -.2 2 width t do. NONE return. end.
    sign*num t
)
parse_group =: 4 : 0
    select. x
    case. 0 do. if. (<y)e.Modifiers do. y else. NONE end.
    case. 1 do. parse_wind y
    case. 2 do.
        if. 7~:#y do. NONE return. end.
        if. ('V'=3{y)*.(3 3 width 3{.y)*.3 3 width 4}.y do.
            (num 3{.y),num 4}.y
        else. NONE end.
    case. 3 do. parse_visibility y
    case. 4 do. parse_rvr y
    case. 5 do. parse_weather y
    case. 6 do. parse_cloud y
    case. 7 do.
        p =. '/' split y
        if. 2~:#p do. NONE return. end.
        for_b. p do.
            t =. >b
            if. 'M'={.t do. t =. }.t end.
            if. -.2 2 width t do. NONE return. end.
        end.
        celsius&>p
    case. 8 do.
        if. (({.y)e.'AQ')*.4 4 width }.y do. (<1{.y),<num }.y else. NONE end.
    case. 9 do. if. y-:'NOSIG' do. 1 else. NONE end.
    end.
)
descriptor =: 3 : 0
    codes =. 1{::y
    if. #codes do. if. ({.codes)e.Descriptors do. >{.codes return. end. end.
    ''
)
phenomena =: 3 : '((1{::y)e.Phenomena)#1{::y'
valid_group =: 4 : 0
    'v s nsw runways' =. y
    select. x
    case. 1 do.
        'variable d speed gust unit' =. v
        if. variable do. if. speed<1 do. 0 return. end.
        else.
            if. (d>360)+.(0~:10|d)+.(d=0)~:speed=0 do. 0 return. end.
        end.
        (gust=_1)+.(-.calm v)*.gust>speed
    case. 2 do.
        if. isnone 1{::s do. 0 return. end.
        (*./v e.10*i.>:36)*.(0~:0{v)*.(0~:1{v)*.((0{v)~:1{v)*.directed 1{::s
    case. 3 do.
        'kind qual meters whole p q joined' =. v
        if. -.kind-:'MILES' do. 1 return. end.
        if. q=0 do. (-.joined)*.whole>:1 else. ((-.joined)+.whole>:1)*.(q e.2 4 8 16)*.(p>:1)*.p<q end.
    case. 4 do.
        'runway readings feet trend' =. v
        if. -.(<runway)e.runways do. 0 return. end.
        if. 1=#readings do. 1 else. (1{::0{::readings)<1{::1{::readings end.
    case. 5 do.
        accepted =. 5{::s
        if. isnone accepted do. accepted =. 0$a: end.
        if. 3<:#accepted do. 0 return. end.
        for_b. accepted do. if. 'NSW'-:2{::>b do. 0 return. end. end.
        if. 'NSW'-:2{::v do. nsw*.0=#accepted return. end.
        codes =. 1{::v
        intensity =. 0{::v
        if. +./(}.codes)e.Descriptors do. 0 return. end.
        p =. phenomena v
        if. (#~.p)~:#p do. 0 return. end.
        if. (0=#p)*.-.(<descriptor v)e.;:'TS SH' do. 0 return. end.
        if. ((<intensity)e.'-';'+')*.-.+./p e.Precipitation do. 0 return. end.
        (2>#p)+.*./p e.Precipitation
    case. 6 do.
        accepted =. 6{::s
        if. (isnone accepted)+.0=#accepted do. 1 return. end.
        last =. >{:accepted
        if. (-.(<0{::v)e.Amounts)+.-.(<0{::last)e.Amounts do. 0 return. end.
        (1{::v)>1{::last
    case. 7 do. (1{v)<:0{v
    case. 8 do.
        'u n' =. v
        if. u-:'A' do. (2500<:n)*.n<:3150 else. (850<:n)*.n<:1070 end.
    case. do. 1
    end.
)
record_group =: 4 : 0
    'kind value' =. x
    if. kind=1 do.
        unit =. 4{::value
        speed =. unit knots 2{::value
        gust =. 3{::value
        if. gust~:_1 do. gust =. unit knots gust end.
        value =. (<speed) 2}value
        value =. (<gust) 3}value
    elseif. kind e.4 5 6 do.
        old =. kind{::y
        if. isnone old do. old =. 0$a: end.
        value =. old,<value
    end.
    (<value) kind}y
)

ScriptPath =: >{:4!:3''
SourceDirectory =: (1+>./_1,I.ScriptPath e.'/\'){.ScriptPath
load SourceDirectory,'units.ijs'
load SourceDirectory,'groups.ijs'
load SourceDirectory,'metar.ijs'
load SourceDirectory,'taf.ijs'
load SourceDirectory,'verification.ijs'

error =: 4 : 0
    Errors =: Errors,<(<x),<y
    i.0
)
read_stations =: 3 : 0
    stations =. 0$a:
    for_b. lines 'input/stations.txt' do.
        ws =. ' ' split >b
        runways =. 0$a:
        for_r. ',' split 2{::ws do.
            p =. '/' split >r
            runways =. runways,<(<0{::p),<num 1{::p
        end.
        elev =. 1{::ws
        sign =. 1
        if. '-'={.elev do. elev =. }.elev
        sign =. _1 end.
        stations =. stations,<(<0{::ws),(<sign*num elev),(<runways),<' ' join 3}.ws
    end.
    stations
)
read_settings =: 3 : 0
    p =. ' '&split&.>lines 'input/params.txt'
    Calendar =: calendar (num 1{::0{::p),num 1{::1{::p
    CrosswindLimit =: num 1{::2{::p
    TailwindLimit =: num 1{::3{::p
    Verify =: }.4{::p
    i.0
)
read_reports =: 3 : 0
    reports =. 0$a:
    for_b. lines 'input/reports.txt' do.
        line =. >b
        continued =. ' '={.line
        while. ' '={.line do. line =. }.line end.
        ws =. ' ' split line
        if. continued do. reports =. (}:reports),< (>{:reports),ws
        else. reports =. reports,<ws end.
    end.
    reports
)
parse_time =: 3 : 0
    if. 7~:#y do. NONE return. end.
    if. ('Z'~:{:y)+.-.6 6 width 6{.y do. NONE return. end.
    d =. num 2{.y
    h =. num 2{.2}.y
    m =. num 2{.4}.y
    if. (d<1)+.(d>2{Calendar)+.(h>23)+.m>59 do. NONE return. end.
    dayminutes d,h,m
)
join_groups =: 4 : 0
    ws =. y
    i =. x
    gs =. 0$a:
    while. i<#ws do.
        pos =. i+1
        t =. i{::ws
        i =. i+1
        if. (1 1 width t)*.i<#ws do.
            following =. i{::ws
            if. 'SM'-:_2{.following do.
                f =. parse_fraction _2}.following
                if. -.isnone f do. t =. t,' ',following
                i =. i+1 end.
            end.
        end.
        gs =. gs,<(<pos),<t
    end.
    gs
)
parse_header =: 3 : 0
    ws =. y
    kind =. 0{::y
    if. -.(<kind)e.;:'METAR SPECI TAF' do.
        1 error 'rejected report, invalid type "',kind,'"'
        NONE return.
    end.
    i =. 1
    modifier =. ''
    station =. time =. start =. finish =. NONE
    if. kind-:'TAF' do.
        if. i<#ws do.
            if. (<i{::ws)e.;:'AMD COR' do. modifier =. i{::ws
            i =. i+1 end.
        end.
    end.
    items =. ;:'station time'
    if. kind-:'TAF' do. items =. items,<'validity' end.
    for_b. items do.
        item =. >b
        if. i=#ws do. (i+1) error 'rejected report, missing ',item
        NONE return. end.
        w =. i{::ws
        valid =. 0
        select. item
        case. 'station' do.
            for_j. i.#Stations do.
                if. w-:0{::j{::Stations do. station =. j
                valid =. 1
                break. end.
            end.
        case. 'time' do. time =. parse_time w
        valid =. -.isnone time
        case. 'validity' do.
            p =. (dayof time) period w
            if. -.isnone p do. 'start finish' =. p
            valid =. finish<:start+1800 end.
        end.
        if. -.valid do. (i+1) error 'rejected report, invalid ',item,' "',w,'"'
        NONE return. end.
        i =. i+1
    end.
    (<kind),(<modifier),(<station),(<time),(<start),(<finish),<i join_groups ws
)
match_groups =: 4 : 0
    'slots nsw runways' =. x
    s =. section ''
    current =. 0
    for_b. y do.
        'pos text' =. >b
        index =. NONE
        value =. NONE
        for_j. current+i.(#slots)-current do.
            value =. (j{slots) parse_group text
            if. -.isnone value do. index =. j
            break. end.
        end.
        if. index=_1 do.
            label =. 'unknown group'
            for_j. i.current do.
                if. -.isnone (j{slots) parse_group text do. label =. 'out of order group'
                break. end.
            end.
            pos error label,' "',text,'"'
            continue.
        end.
        kind =. index{slots
        if. -.kind valid_group (<value),(<s),(<nsw),<runways do.
            pos error 'invalid group "',text,'"'
            continue.
        end.
        s =. ((<kind),<value) record_group s
        if. (kind=3)*.'CAVOK'-:0{::value do.
            s =. (<0$a:) 5}s
            s =. (<0$a:) 6}s
            current =. 1+slots i.6
        else. current =. index+-.kind e.Repeatable end.
    end.
    s
)
forecast_state =: 4 : 'state ((<TafSlots),(<x),<0$a:) match_groups y'
decode_forecast =: 4 : 0
    h =. y
    f =. (<x),(<2{::h),(<3{::h),(<1{::h),(<4{::h),(<5{::h),(<NONE),<0$a:
    'base changes' =. f split_changes 6{::h
    f =. (<0 forecast_state base) 6}f
    decoded =. 0$a:
    for_b. changes do.
        c =. >b
        c =. (<1 forecast_state 3{::c) 4}c
        decoded =. decoded,<c
    end.
    (<decoded) 7}f
)
ceiling =: 3 : 0
    clouds =. 3{::y
    if. isnone clouds do. NONE return. end.
    for_b. clouds do.
        c =. >b
        if. (<0{::c)e.;:'BKN OVC VV' do. 1{::c return. end.
    end.
    NONE
)
category =: 3 : 0
    c =. ceiling y
    if. isnone c do. c =. 1000000 end.
    p =. 1x
    q =. 0x
    if. -.isnone 1{::y do. 'p q' =. miles 1{::y end.
    if. (c<500)+.p<q do. 'LIFR'
    elseif. (c<1000)+.p<3*q do. 'IFR'
    elseif. (c<:3000)+.p<:5*q do. 'MVFR'
    else. 'VFR' end.
)
inhg_value =: 3 : 'if. ''A''-:0{::y do. 1{::y else. inhg 1{::y end.'
components =: 3 : 0
    'direction heading speed' =. y
    angle =. direction-heading
    ((speed*icos angle) div 1000),(speed*isin angle) div 1000
)
runway_winds =: 4 : 0
    wind =. y
    if. isnone wind do. NONE return. end.
    if. -.directed wind do. NONE return. end.
    winds =. 0$a:
    for_b. 2{::x{::Stations do.
        r =. >b
        mean =. components (1{::wind),(1{::r),2{::wind
        gust =. NONE
        if. _1~:3{::wind do. gust =. components (1{::wind),(1{::r),3{::wind end.
        deciding =. mean
        if. -.isnone gust do. deciding =. gust end.
        usable =. ((|1{deciding)<:CrosswindLimit)*.(-0{deciding)<:TailwindLimit
        winds =. winds,<(<0{::r),(<mean),(<gust),<usable
    end.
    winds
)
wind_changes =: 3 : 0
    'a b alpha' =. y
    reasons =. 0$a:
    if. (isnone a)+.isnone b do. reasons return. end.
    d =. 360|| (1{::a)-1{::b
    if. (directed a)*.(directed b)*.(10<:(2{::a)>.2{::b)*.(d<.360-d)>:alpha do.
        reasons =. reasons,<'wind shift'
    end.
    if. 10<:|(2{::a)-2{::b do. reasons =. reasons,<'wind speed' end.
    reasons
)
has_thunderstorm =: 3 : 0
    w =. 2{::y
    if. isnone w do. 0 return. end.
    for_b. w do. if. 'TS'-:descriptor >b do. 1 return. end. end.
    0
)
has_freezing =: 3 : 0
    w =. 2{::y
    if. isnone w do. 0 return. end.
    for_b. w do.
        if. ('FZ'-:descriptor >b)*.+./(phenomena >b)e.;:'DZ RA' do. 1 return. end.
    end.
    0
)
speci_reasons =: 4 : 0
    if. isnone x do. <'no previous report' return. end.
    before =. state 4{::x
    now =. state 4{::y
    reasons =. 0$a:
    if. -.(9{::x)-:9{::y do. reasons =. reasons,<'category ',(9{::x),' to ',9{::y end.
    reasons =. reasons,wind_changes (<0{::before),(<0{::now),<45
    if. (has_thunderstorm before)~:has_thunderstorm now do.
        if. has_thunderstorm now do. text =. 'thunderstorm began' else. text =. 'thunderstorm ended' end.
        reasons =. reasons,<text
    end.
    if. (has_freezing before)~:has_freezing now do.
        if. has_freezing now do. text =. 'freezing precipitation began' else. text =. 'freezing precipitation ended' end.
        reasons =. reasons,<text
    end.
    if. 0=#reasons do. <'no criteria met' else. reasons end.
)
decode_observation =: 4 : 0
    'number h previous' =. y
    station =. 2{::h
    runways =. 0$a:
    for_b. 2{::station{::Stations do. runways =. runways,<0{::>b end.
    'mainpart trendpart remarks' =. split_body 6{::h
    s =. ((<MainSlots),(<0),<runways) match_groups mainpart
    trends =. 0$a:
    for_b. trend_sections trendpart do.
        t =. read_trend >b
        if. -.isnone t do.
            ts =. ((<TrendSlots),(<1),<0$a:) match_groups 2{::t
            trends =. trends,<t,<state ts
        end.
    end.
    'slp temps' =. read_remarks remarks
    st =. state s
    pa =. da =. NONE
    if. -.isnone 8{::s do.
        pa =. (1{::station{::Stations)+10*2992-inhg_value 8{::s
        if. -.isnone 7{::s do.
            da =. pa+(120*((1000*0{7{::s)-15000)+2*pa) div 1000
        end.
    end.
    o =. (<number),(<0{::h),(<station),(<3{::h),(<s),(<trends),(<slp),(<temps),(<ceiling st),(<category st),(<pa),(<da),(<station runway_winds 0{::st),<0$a:
    if. 'SPECI'-:0{::h do. o =. (<previous speci_reasons o) 13}o end.
    o
)

qualifier_word =: 3 : 0
    if. y-:'M' do. 'less than ' elseif. y-:'P' do. 'more than ' else. '' end.
)
wind_phrase =: 3 : 0
    'variable d speed gust unit' =. y
    if. calm y do. t =. 'calm'
    elseif. variable do. t =. 'variable at ',(number speed),' KT'
    else. t =. (3 pad d),' degrees at ',(number speed),' KT' end.
    if. gust~:_1 do. t =. t,' gusting ',(number gust),' KT' end.
    t
)
mile_number =: 3 : 0
    'kind qual meters whole p q joined' =. y
    if. q=0 do. number whole return. end.
    t =. (number p),'/',number q
    if. whole>0 do. t =. (number whole),' ',t end.
    t
)
visibility_phrase =: 3 : 0
    'kind qual meters whole p q joined' =. y
    if. kind-:'CAVOK' do. '10 km or more (CAVOK)'
    elseif. kind-:'METERS' do.
        if. qual-:'P' do. '10 km or more' else. (number meters),' m' end.
    else. (qualifier_word qual),(mile_number y),' SM' end.
)
weather_phrase =: 3 : 0
    'intensity codes text' =. y
    if. text-:'NSW' do. 'no significant weather' return. end.
    parts =. 0$a:
    if. #intensity do. parts =. parts,<((;:'- + VC')i.<intensity){::;:'light heavy nearby' end.
    d =. descriptor y
    if. #d do. parts =. parts,<(Descriptors i.<d){::DescriptorWords end.
    ps =. phenomena y
    if. #ps do. parts =. parts,<' and ' join (Phenomena i.ps){PhenomenonWords end.
    ' ' join parts
)
cloud_phrase =: 3 : 0
    'amount height ctype text' =. y
    if. (<amount)e.Clear do. (Clear i.<amount){::ClearWords return. end.
    if. amount-:'VV' do. 'vertical visibility ',(number height),' ft' return. end.
    t =. ((Amounts i.<amount){::AmountWords),' at ',(number height),' ft'
    if. #ctype do. t =. t,' ',(CloudTypes i.<ctype){::CloudTypeWords end.
    t
)
summary =: 3 : 0
    'wind visibility weather cloud' =. y
    parts =. 0$a:
    if. -.isnone wind do. parts =. parts,<'wind ',wind_phrase wind end.
    if. -.isnone visibility do. parts =. parts,<'visibility ',visibility_phrase visibility end.
    if. -.isnone weather do.
        if. #weather do. parts =. parts,<'weather ',', ' join weather_phrase&.>weather end.
    end.
    if. -.isnone cloud do.
        if. #cloud do. parts =. parts,<'cloud ',', ' join cloud_phrase&.>cloud end.
    end.
